reason: The picture says higher blood glucose triggers insulin release from the pancreatic cells, matching the first goal.
expectation: The pancreatic cells will release insulin into the blood.

effect: Insulin is now in the blood and can carry the message to muscle.
reaction: The route toward muscle makes the next step clear.
reason: The muscle hotspot has receptors for blood-carried insulin, and the goal is to store glucose there.

choice.with: Muscle fibres beside a blood vessel

expectation: Insulin will signal the muscle to take in glucose and store some of it.

effect: The muscle stored glucose, completing the insulin goal; the remaining goal concerns the liver's message.
reaction: It helped to see that insulin stays outside the cells rather than becoming part of the store.
reason: The pancreatic cell picture links lower blood glucose to release of the other hormone, matching the remaining goal.
expectation: The pancreatic cells will release the hormone that signals the liver.

effect: The lower-glucose sample produced a blood-carried message that can signal the liver to release stored glucose.
reaction: The labelled route makes the hormone's purpose clear.
reason: The liver cells are the destination for the message, and the liver carbohydrate store is available there.
expectation: The message will help the liver break down its carbohydrate store and release glucose.

effect: The liver message used the stored carbohydrate to release glucose into the blood, completing the remaining goal.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the store get smaller while the liver cells stayed intact.

mostWorthwhile.text: Sending insulin to the muscle was worthwhile because it showed the difference between a chemical message and the glucose used to make a store.

leastWorthwhile.text: Releasing the second pancreatic message felt a little repetitive after releasing insulin, although the different glucose level explained why it happened.

surprise.text: I noticed that insulin stays outside the muscle cells while glucose enters and becomes part of the store.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained both hormone pairings and their destinations.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see another body process connected this clearly, though the pairings here were fairly predictable.
